title: Gerente de vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de vendas em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

CARREIRAS PARA SORRIR


Na PepsiCo, você descobrirá um lugar onde nossa missão é criar sorrisos em todo o mundo. Com um portfólio de mais de 500 marcas adoradas, incluindo Gatorade, Lay’s e Quaker, nosso trabalho toca milhões de pessoas todos os dias.


No coração da empresa está uma equipe de pensadores, criadores e solucionadores de problemas que colaboram para inovar e transformar ideias em ação. Impulsionados pela inovação e pelo foco em criar momentos de alegria por meio de alimentos e bebidas, nossas decisões são guiadas pela centralidade no consumidor, criando oportunidades para que nossos associados realizem um trabalho significativo e gerem um impacto duradouro nas comunidades que atendemos.


Seja qual for o seu papel, você fará parte de uma comunidade global que valoriza suas ideias e o capacita a causar impacto, tanto em sua carreira quanto no mundo ao seu redor.



A oportunidade


- Responsável pelo planejamento, gestão e controle das operações comerciais no mercado onde atua, visando atingir as previsões de faturamento nos limites de despesas previstas no orçamento;

- Planeja, organiza e gerencia as ações dos clientes sob sua responsabilidade, desenvolvendo estratégias e ações para alcançar e/ou superar os objetivos estabelecidos pela Cia., respeitando a política comercial e mantendo o crescimento sustentável de sua unidade de negócios;

- Assegurar o desenvolvimento dos recursos humanos sob sua responsabilidade;

- Atuar com base nos Valores, Princípios e Código de Conduta.




O seu impacto


- Representar a empresa no desenvolvimento das relações comerciais com os principais clientes da companhia;

- Atingir periodicamente os objetivos de volume, respeitando as políticas comerciais, e metas internas da Companhia;

- Manter a empresa informada sobre as ações de mercado, a fim de alimentar nossas ferramentas gerenciais e indicadores chave de performance;

- Analisar regularmente as ferramentas internas disponíveis além dos demais relatórios diversos de kpi´s, fornecidos pelas áreas de apoio, conectando os dados com as análises de mercado obtidas de store check, visitas comerciais e relatórios Nielsen, para identificar oportunidades e propor soluções, formalizadas em um plano de ação;

- Analisar os indicadores de performance do desempenho dos seus clientes para tomada de decisões;

- Desenvolver a equipe sob sua responsabilidade direta seguindo o Modelo de Desenvolvimento de Carreira da PepsiCo.

- Planejar e acompanhar as entregas, com negociações de volume adequadas às regras de palletização e com o melhor faseamento dentro do mês, contribuindo para solucionar/ eliminar dificuldades de entrega e devoluções de mercadorias;

- Desenvolver o Modelo de Gestão Pepsico para sua região dentro da sua respectiva área de atuação, conhecendo adequadamente seu cliente e atuando como parceiro de negócio;

- Desenvolver calendário de atividades promocionais alinhado com as estratégias da empresa, gerenciando acordos (contratos) comerciais para garantir o crescimento dos volumes negociados, bem como também fortalecer a parceria comercial;

- Garantir cadastro dos produtos nos clientes sob sua responsabilidade e manter a equipe de execução informada a respeito do status do cadastramento;

- Garantir que seus clientes estejam operando com o mix de produtos adequados para a região;

- Propor inclusão de novos clientes importantes em sua região;

- Acompanhar periodicamente a situação de crédito de seus clientes junto ao departamento de crédito e cobrança, e informar qualquer anormalidade financeira dos mesmos.



Quem estamos buscando?


- Formação/Curso: Superior completo em áreas relacionadas à função.

- Experiência sólida na na área de Vendas de bens de consumo, com clientes de pequeno e médio varejo, preferencialmente no ramo de alimentos, atuando como gestor de equipe direta.

- Pacote Office: Intermediário

- Disponibilidade para viagens (rota, viagens curtas)

- Experiência com sistema SAP (diferencial)




Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.



O que você pode esperar da gente?



Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:



  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.



Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi


At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.


Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity.

Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements.


The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership.


Location

Remote – Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.


Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership

  • Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil.
  • Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure.
  • Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives.
  • Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions.

Regulatory & Corporate Governance

  • Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities.
  • Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) , financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders.
  • Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives.

Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships

  • Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil.
  • Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners.
  • Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth.
  • Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America.
  • Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions.

Organizational Development

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries.
  • Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment.
  • Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology.
  • Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil.
  • Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers.
  • Experience working within multinational or global organizations.
  • Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure.
  • Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives.


Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.


Why Join VelaFi?

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement.

Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments.


Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset , we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets.

title: Head of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Bilingual Customer Service Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bilingual Customer Service Representative em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT MASTERPRO

MasterPro Installs is a U.S. appliance delivery and installation company operating in the U.S. We are an authorized installer for some of the largest retailers in the United States. Our trucks deliver and install refrigerators, ranges, dishwashers, and cooktops in customers' homes every day, and our remote team in Brazil is the voice our customers hear before and after every visit.

THE ROLE

You will be the direct line between MasterPro and our U.S. customers. You will confirm appointments, solve scheduling problems, follow up after installations, and make sure every customer interaction ends better than it started. You will work inside our CRM and operations systems all day; everything you do gets documented, tracked, and measured. Our field teams are scored on customer surveys, and your work directly moves those scores.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Handle inbound and outbound customer contact by phone, SMS, and email: appointment confirmations, rescheduling, arrival windows, and post-installation follow-up.

• Work daily inside our CRM and operations platforms, keeping every customer record complete, accurate, and up to date — no exceptions.

• Coordinate in real time with U.S.-based dispatch and field teams to solve same-day problems: delays, access issues, product problems, and customer questions.

• Drive customer survey participation and satisfaction after every completed job — our teams are measured on surveys, and you own the follow-up that makes them happen.

• De-escalate frustrated customers with patience and professionalism, and turn complaints into resolved cases with documented outcomes.

• Flag recurring issues and process gaps to management — we promote problem-solvers, not ticket-closers.

REQUIRED

• Fluent, professional English — spoken and written. You will talk with American customers by phone all day. Interviews are conducted 100% in English.

• Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Monday.com, or similar). You know how to live inside a CRM: logging, updating, searching, and following workflows.

• 100% remote readiness: reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional workspace, a computer in good condition, and a quality headset.

• Availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours (afternoon/evening in Brazil).

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience serving U.S. or other international customers.

• Experience with Monday.com, scheduling systems, or logistics/home-services operations.

• Spanish, in addition to English — many of our customers are bilingual.

WHAT WE OFFER

• 100% remote work from anywhere in Brazil, on a long-term engagement with a growing U.S. company.

• Compensation in line with experience, paid reliably every month.

• Real growth: our Brazil team members grow into finance, operations, and coordination roles as the company expands into new U.S. markets.

• Direct exposure to U.S. operations, tools, and standards — you will work with modern systems and real automation, not spreadsheets and improvisation.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on LinkedIn AND send your resume in English to with the subject line \"Customer Service — Brazil\". Include one short paragraph, in English, telling us about a difficult customer you turned around. Applications without the paragraph will not be reviewed — that paragraph is the first test.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veterinary Radiologist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Implementation Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Implementation Manager with 3+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, or client success to join our U.S. client. In this role, you will serve as the primary project manager during client onboarding, guiding new clients through a seamless implementation experience while providing strategic guidance to help them maximize the value of the platform.

Our client provides industry-leading environmental compliance, fuel management, and facility maintenance software used by major fuel networks, including global brands. Their platform helps companies monitor and optimize operations by delivering real-time insights, automating compliance tasks, and ensuring site uptime.

With a mission to make sustainability and operational efficiency seamless, our client is transforming how fuel networks operate. As part of their dynamic, fast-paced engineering team, you'll have the opportunity to work on cloud-based, data-driven solutions that have a direct impact on performance, compliance, and environmental responsibility.


Responsibilities

  • Build strong relationships with new clients to ensure a smooth and successful onboarding experience
  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to support new business and lead a seamless handoff from sales to customer success
  • Serve as the primary project manager during implementation, ensuring timelines, milestones, and deliverables are met
  • Deliver training sessions to educate clients on platform applications and best practices
  • Provide strategic guidance and recommendations to help clients maximize the value and efficiency of the platform's solutions
  • Offer ongoing support and proactive follow-up during the first six months of product adoption
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of client-facing documentation, guides, and resources
  • Perform additional duties as needed to support team and business objectives


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders ranging from Fortune 500 executives to operational teams
  • Bachelor's degree required (or equivalent experience)
  • 3+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, or client success roles, preferably within a SaaS environment
  • Proficiency with technology platforms and data analysis to support client solutions and decision-making
  • Demonstrated strength in project management, including gathering and translating functional requirements
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly detail-oriented, organized, and proactive, with a strong commitment to delivering an exceptional client experience
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% as needed
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Industry experience in fuel supply, logistics, and/or fuel compliance
  • Advanced degree
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

Sobre a Liora

Todo brasileiro paga conta de luz. Mas ninguém ainda tinha transformado esse boleto em infraestrutura financeira — até a Liora. Somos uma energyfintech que converte a economia gerada por energia limpa em crédito, cashback e benefícios reais para PMEs e consumidores.

Fundada por ex-executivos de Loft, Guiabolso, Moip e Kovi. Investida por Canary, 17Sigma e 468 Capital. E crescendo num ritmo que faz cada liderança importar de verdade.

A Liora precisa de uma liderança em Salvador que monte, treine e faça o time de vendas local voar.

Você não vai só gerenciar números. Vai estruturar canal, desenvolver pessoas, definir rotas, e garantir que a Liora se torne a referência em economia de energia na região. É uma posição de construção real, com autonomia total e impacto direto no crescimento da empresa.

Se você já liderou time comercial, sabe o que é montar e estruturar uma operação, e quer construir algo grande — essa vaga é sua.


No seu dia a dia, você vai:

  • Estruturar e executar a estratégia de expansão por rotas na região
  • Recrutar, fazer onboarding e desenvolver o time de vendas local
  • Estabelecer metas por vendedor e acompanhar indicadores de perto
  • Implementar rotinas de planejamento diário, reuniões matinais e role plays
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar parcerias locais alinhadas à cultura da Liora
  • Clusterizar cidades e perfis de clientes mais aderentes à oferta
  • Trazer inteligência de mercado para produto, marketing e operações


O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência liderando times comerciais — de preferência em campo ou canal
  • Vivência em estruturação de operação de vendas do zero
  • Visão analítica: CAC, LTV, rentabilidade por tier de cliente
  • Perfil executor: testa rápido, aprende, ajusta sem perder o ritmo
  • Comunicação direta, feedback honesto e capacidade de desenvolver pessoas
  • Mentalidade de dono — se sente responsável pelo resultado e pela cultura


Será um diferencial

  • Experiência em vendas consultivas B2B ou mercados complexos
  • Conhecimento no setor de energia, telecom ou infraestrutura
  • Vivência em startup ou empresa em crescimento acelerado


Nossa proposta de valor

️ Vale-refeição

Salário fixo + variável por performance do time

title: Consultor/Escritório Parceiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor/Escritório Parceiro em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT. É uma parceria.

O mercado está migrando da remuneração por produto para a consultoria fee-based. Cada vez mais consultores querem operar assim, mas esbarram na estrutura que isso exige: research, alocação, back-office, compliance, tecnologia e custódia rodando ao mesmo tempo.


A Nord abre sua rede de parceiros especializados para quem quer crescer sem carregar essa operação sozinho. Você mantém sua marca, sua autonomia e a relação direta com o cliente. A Nord assume a infraestrutura.


A proposta é estender a estrutura que sustenta a nossa própria operação de wealth em benefício do crescimento de operações parceiras.


Você cuida do que ninguém faz no seu lugar: o relacionamento e a proximidade com o cliente.

Bankers que já atendem clientes e querem escalar.

Escritórios independentes buscando estrutura completa sem montar tudo do zero.


Se você já atende clientes e quer parar de carregar a operação sozinho, candidate-se. Nosso time entra em contato para uma conversa sem compromisso.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy & Operations Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R

Compensation range

  • Poland: PLN12,600 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Lithuania: €2,500 - €8,000 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

Seeking a freelance project that will allow you to work from home while making a difference in the world of technology? If you are someone who is passionate and enjoys staying ahead of the tech curve this part-time remote project with flexible working hours might be what you are looking for!

  • In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout
  • Your ultimate goal will be to contribute towards making internet search and online advertising more relevant and interesting for millions of users, including yourself.

  • Access to complimentary mental health support benefits like free EAP and Mindfulness Apps.

TELUS Digital AI Community

title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de IA Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA

que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção.


Esta não é uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção.


O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA

Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter:


• Orquestrador: Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara

agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta

comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update.

• Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert): cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade.

• Rules: Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent.

• Recovery loops: quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota.

• Multi-repo via submodules: projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar.

• Stack: Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq,

integrações HTTP com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy.


O que você vai fazer


Manutenção do core (40%)

• Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade

ciclomática.

• Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem

determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário.

• Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento.

• Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue).

• Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva.


Evolução de agents e rules (35%)

• Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist).

• Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho.

• Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev

ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146).

• Criar/refatorar skills.

• Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B).


Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)

• Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct).

• Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex:

DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação).

• Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve.

• Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient;

expandir cobertura).

• Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection —

entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria.


O que esperamos de você


Stack técnica — obrigatório

• Bash/Shell avançado e Linux — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de

bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs,

parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de ((

e porque importa.

• Node.js / TypeScript — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não usar Node

(ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS).

• Git e GitHub avançado — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr

create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução

de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows.

• Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que não fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o

efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou.


Experiência

• 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção.

• Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs em ambiente

real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\".

• Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\".

• Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time).


Mentalidade

• Determinismo > magia. Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável.

• Forensics sobre intuição. Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese.

• Documentação executável. Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta.

• Empatia por agente. Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar.


Diferenciais

• Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes.

• Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker em integrações com APIs externas instáveis.

• Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende

os trade-offs.

• Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent

frameworks).

• Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves.

• Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico

(feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick).

• Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam.


Benefícios

• Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco

• Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life

• Day Off de Aniversário

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Job Title: Vertex Brazil Tax Consultant / Implementation Lead (Cloud)


Location : Remote (Preferred candidates in Brazil or India; must be able to support client time zones)


Duration : 6 to 12 Months (Contract)



Industry: Financial Services


Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly experienced Vertex Brazil Tax Consultant / Implementation Lead to support a large-scale Brazil tax implementation project for a financial services client. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Brazilian tax regulations, strong hands-on experience implementing Vertex Cloud (latest version) and the ability to lead a full implementation from greenfield / scratch through go-live.


This resource will play a critical role in designing, configuring and deploying Brazil tax capabilities within Vertex, ensuring compliance with local tax requirements and seamless integration into the client’s enterprise systems.


Key Responsibilities:

● Lead end-to-end implementation of Brazil tax configuration in Vertex Cloud (latest release)

● Analyze and translate complex Brazilian tax requirements (including indirect tax, VAT-equivalent structures, invoicing and compliance requirements) into Vertex solution design

● Configure, customize and optimize Vertex tax rules, tax determination logic and reporting

● Work with business, finance, tax and IT stakeholders to gather requirements and define implementation strategy

● Provide architecture guidance and best practices for greenfield Vertex implementations

● Support integration between Vertex and ERP / financial systems

● Conduct testing, validation, troubleshooting and issue resolution during implementation

● Ensure compliance with Brazil tax regulations and industry-specific financial services requirements

● Provide knowledge transfer and implementation documentation


Required Skills & Experience:

● 7+ years of tax technology / implementation experience

● Strong expertise in Vertex with hands-on experience in the latest Cloud version

● Proven experience implementing Vertex from scratch (greenfield implementation)

● Deep knowledge of Brazil tax regulations and compliance requirements

● Prior experience supporting Brazil tax localization projects

● Experience in Financial Services / Banking / Insurance environments

● Strong functional and technical understanding of tax engines and tax determination logic

● Ability to work independently and lead workshops with senior stakeholders

● Excellent communication and documentation skills


Preferred Qualifications:

● Candidate based in Brazil (highly preferred due to local tax expertise), though strong candidates in India will also be considered

● Experience integrating Vertex with enterprise platforms such as SAP , Oracle or other ERP systems

● Consulting background with large global transformation programs


Additional Notes:

● Client is currently on the latest Vertex Cloud platform

● Resource must be capable of owning the Brazil tax workstream with minimal ramp-up

● Contract expected to run 6 months to 1 year, depending on project scope, budget, and delivery timeline

title: Senior DBA + C#/.NET Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DBA + C#/.NET Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior Database Administrator with C#/.NET development experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will interact with/improve code related to our software database queries, while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide.


As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists to join our global network of creators.


Role Overview


As a Freelance Voice Over Artist, you will bring complex characters and gripping stories to life in serialized audio fiction. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series.


This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration.


Requirements


  • Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles.
  • Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting.
  • Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet.
  • Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules.
  • Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management
  • Experience working remotely with production teams


Engagement Details

  • Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote (Work from your own studio)
  • Compensation: Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis.

How to Apply : Please fill in


What happens after you apply?


Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline:

1.Internal Evaluation:

Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects.

2.Show Casting & Voice Testing:

If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision.

3.Contract & Legal Alignment:

Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms.

4.Calibration & Onboarding:

Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow.

5.Production & Monthly Deliveries:

Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span 150 to 300 hours in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of 20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month until the series is complete.

title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies

Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.


Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.


Was du machst

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.


Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.


Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.


Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch.
  • Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.


Was zusätzlich hilft

  • Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse
  • Englisch fließend
  • Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung
  • Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business
  • Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas


Was wir bieten

  • Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt.
  • Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen.
  • Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen.
  • Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst.
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.

    • Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

7.Garantir que as etapas da esteira avancem somente após o cumprimento dos critérios de aprovação, documentação e aceite estabelecidos.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

11.Acompanhar a aderência entre horas planejadas e horas executadas, identificando variações relevantes e apoiando a análise de suas causas.

12.Apoiar as lideranças na priorização das demandas, considerando capacidade das equipes, prazos, dependências, riscos e impacto financeiro.

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.

Nooro is developing an innovative APP that aims to revolutionize the health app market, helping individuals with various health issues. We are seeking ambitious and dedicated individuals to join our creative team!

title: VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil


The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.


We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


About The Render Pros / VEXOS


We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


The Role


The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.


You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


✅ What You'll Be Responsible For


• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM

• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials

• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person

• Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date

• Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track

• Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed

• Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We're Looking For


Experience

• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role

• Experience working with SaaS platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus

• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement


Skills

• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily

• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly

• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure

• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift


Mindset

• You follow through. Every time.

• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated

• You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients

• You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


🛠 Tools You'll Work With


VEXOS platform (proprietary) · Notion or Asana · Zoom · Google Workspace · Loom


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We Offer


• Competitive salary in USD

• 100% remote — work from Brazil or Mexico

• Direct day-to-day collaboration with the founder

• A stable, long-term role in a growing company

• Opportunity to grow into greater responsibility as VEXOS scales


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


How to Apply


Send your CV and a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) covering:

1. Who you are and what you've managed

2. Why this role interests you

3. One example of how you handled a difficult client situation


Applications without the Loom video will not be reviewed.


Apply via DM or email:

#hiring #remotejobs #vexos #therenderpos #proptech #projectmanager #clientsuccess #remotework #Brazil #Mexico #latinamerica
