title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategic Customer Success Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.


Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.


How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.


Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

7.Garantir que as etapas da esteira avancem somente após o cumprimento dos critérios de aprovação, documentação e aceite estabelecidos.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

11.Acompanhar a aderência entre horas planejadas e horas executadas, identificando variações relevantes e apoiando a análise de suas causas.

12.Apoiar as lideranças na priorização das demandas, considerando capacidade das equipes, prazos, dependências, riscos e impacto financeiro.

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About U S

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

•Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collection issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to the Controller for review and payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the StaffAccountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in the financial package

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review the new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports, including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to the Staff Accountant


Requirements

4+ years of accounting experience

Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S.GAAP

Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)

Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)

Fluent English (written and spoken)

Accounting or Finance degree

Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST


Benefits

Ful ly remote role with some flexibility included

Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes

Access to TGG University and learning resources

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor

Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

Loyalty

Integrity

Strong Work Ethic

Forward Thinking - Grow The Mindset

Team Player / Caring / Selfless

Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh

Freedom & Accountability

title: Finance Services Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Services Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

The Finance team keeps Revolut moving with clarity and confidence. From accounting to strategic support, they work across the business to assess risk, guide decisions, and drive growth. Their insight shapes everything from daily operations to long-term plans and plays a key role in how we scale.

We're looking for a motivated Finance Services Manager to manage treasury account onboarding processes and financial portal accesses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Ensuring group treasury accounts are managed and maintained effectively
  • Managing portal access so key stakeholders have the correct permissions to keep the business running smoothly
  • Scaling operations by ensuring new entities are set up correctly and controlled from a group treasury and finance perspective
  • Supporting Settlements, Trade, and Support teams where needed
  • Building and maintaining relationships with vendors to ensure business continuity
  • Implementing new tools and processes to improve overall team performance
  • Enhancing controls and documentation of current trading and funding processes
  • Managing risk and control metrics, such as KRIs, KPIs, and SLAs


What you'll need

  • 3+ years of experience in financial services, ideally in treasury, onboarding, or payments
  • Experience in a reputable and high-growth bank or fintech
  • Knowledge of various financial instruments
  • Expertise in delivering change and continuous improvement
  • A good understanding of key treasury or finance functions
  • Experience in risk and control management


Nice to have

  • Knowledge of SQL, Excel, and/or Python with impressive data analysis skills
  • Solid relationship management, project management, and leadership skills



Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

  • Location: Brazil - Remote
  • Employment type: Full-time contractor
  • Compensation: Up to USD 7,500 per month


About Us

LDH by Stefanini is part of Stefanini Group, a global technology company delivering digital transformation, IT consulting, and nearshore talent solutions for enterprise clients across North America and Latin America.


About the Role

We are looking for a senior SAP IBP & S&OP Solution Architect to support a strategic SAP planning and transformation project for a global enterprise client in the automotive manufacturing industry.

The role is ideal for a hands-on SAP planning consultant or architect who can operate between business and technology, lead business conversations, translate planning needs into SAP solutions, and support the implementation of scalable planning processes in a manufacturing environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design SAP S/4HANA and SAP IBP solutions for Sales & Operations Planning.
  • Lead S&OP workshops with stakeholders across supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, sales, and finance.
  • Gather requirements and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
  • Document As-Is and To-Be processes, gap analysis, and solution recommendations.
  • Configure and support SAP IBP, SAP APO, and related S&OP planning capabilities.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology.


This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.


About Ten16 Creative

Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.


We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.


About the Role

The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.


This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.


You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.


You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.


You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.


Qualifications

The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.


They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page.


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto de soluções - IA Microsoft em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções - IA & Intelligent Applications


Estamos buscando um(a) profissional com foco em IA aplicada no Azure. Você vai atuar diretamente com clientes, liderando engajamentos técnicos de ponta a ponta: desde o design de arquitetura até a implantação em produção de soluções inteligentes com Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio e ecossistema Microsoft AI. O foco é remover bloqueios técnicos, acelerar adoção e garantir que as soluções de IA saiam do PoC para escala real.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência com Fundamentos de IA e LLMs: Entendimento sólido de como LLMs funcionam, como o tokens, contexto, temperatura, hallucination e grounding. - Experiência prática com prompt engineering: system prompts, few-shot, chain-of-thought e instrução estruturada. -Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura de IA: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agentes com tool use e orquestração de múltiplos agentes. - Familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade de modelos: métricas como relevância, fundamentação e coerência.
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry: Criação de projetos, deploy de modelos e configuração de endpoints. - Uso do model catalog, fine-tuning e avaliação de modelos dentro do Foundry. - Configuração de grounding com Azure AI Search (indexação, chunking, estratégias de retrieval). - Integração com Azure OpenAI Service e outros modelos disponíveis no Foundry.
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio: Experiência com criação de agentes no Copilot Studio na criação de tópicos, entidades, variáveis e fluxo conversacional. - Integração de agentes com fontes de conhecimento externas (SharePoint, sites, documentos). - Configuração de actions e conexão com Power Automate para automações a partir do agente. - Publicação e deployment de agentes em canais (Teams, web, outros)
  • Experiência com Arquitetura e Cloud: Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas orientadas a IA no Azure (AI Foundry + Search + Storage + Function/App Service). - Entendimento de segurança aplicada a IA: managed identity, RBAC, data residency, responsible AI. - Habilidade de comunicar arquiteturas técnicas para públicos técnicos e executivos.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions para CI/CD de soluções de IA (MLOps light);
  • Familiaridade com Python para prototipagem rápida, scripts de indexação ou integração com SDKs de IA;
  • Conhecimento de Azure Functions ou Logic Apps para automação serverless;
  • Experiência com Azure API Management (APIM) para expor e governar endpoints de IA;
  • Familiaridade com conectores customizados e extensões de agente (Copilot extensibility);
  • Conhecimento de Azure SQL, Cosmos DB ou PostgreSQL para persistência em soluções de IA;
  • Experiência com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) ou containerização de modelos/aplicações;
  • Familiaridade com monitoramento de IA: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, logging de prompts/respostas;
  • Certificação AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate);
  • Certificação PL-100 / PL-200 (Power Platform);
  • Certificação AZ-204 (Azure Developer Associate);




Modelo de atuação: Home Office, mas precisa ter disponibilidade para viajar esporadicamente;

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contracting Manager, Activities Bank, Travel Industry em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Manager – Activities


About Us

At HBX Group , we are a global TravelTech ecosystem connecting and empowering businesses across the world of travel. Through data, innovation, and strong partnerships, we deliver seamless experiences and help our partners grow.

Within our Activities division, we focus on building competitive, high-quality product portfolios that meet evolving market demands. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where ownership, adaptability, and collaboration are key to success.


Job Summary

As a Contract Manager , you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs.

This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution , with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement . You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive revenue, maintain product quality, and unlock growth opportunities.


Job Responsibilities

Supplier & Portfolio Management

  • Manage a portfolio of Activities suppliers, ensuring product availability and competitiveness at all times.
  • Maintain and develop strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the main point of contact.
  • Ensure existing products remain optimized and aligned with market expectations.


Contracting & Negotiation

  • Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms.
  • Ensure renewal contracts are competitive and available in time to capture demand.
  • Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze portfolio performance through bi-weekly reports and statistics , identifying trends and opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and take actions to improve conversion, revenue, and product performance.
  • Provide insights and explanations on portfolio performance using data and market knowledge.


Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines.
  • Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability).
  • Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams).
  • Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities.
  • Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits.


Required Skills

  • Strong prioritization and time management , with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously.
  • High level of analytical thinking , comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics.
  • Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills .
  • High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.


Required Tech Skills

  • Intermediate Excel skills (data analysis, reporting, tracking KPIs).
  • Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms .
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.
  • Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.
  • Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

description:

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.

Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras.

Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
  • Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
  • Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.


Requerimentos & Skills:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos.
  • Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop
  • Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. title: Solutions Engineer — Warehouse Automation & Robotics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Engineer — Warehouse Automation & Robotics em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Shape the future of warehouse automation with a global leader in AMR robotics.

Our client is a global leader in Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) solutions is transforming how warehouses pick, move, and sort at scale. With rapid growth across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, our client is looking for a Solutions Engineer to help turn complex logistics challenges into intelligent, robot-driven solutions.

If you love translating operational problems into elegant automation designs, this is your role.


What you'll do

You'll be the technical bridge between clients and the robotics — designing tailored automation solutions and seeing them through to deployment.

  • Design & consult: Engage clients to understand their operations and goals, then architect customized AMR solutions that optimize warehouse workflows.
  • Own the technical story: Serve as the subject-matter expert on the company's products. Produce solution architecture, system specs, and layouts that engineering and implementation teams can execute.
  • Collaborate to deploy: Partner with WMS/WES software engineers to define requirements and ensure seamless, on-time deployments. Coordinate with contractors where robotics meet broader logistics operations.
  • Win and grow accounts: Build and deliver compelling proposals around operational benefits, ROI, and deployment roadmaps aligned with each client's growth strategy.


What you bring

  • Bachelor's in Supply Chain Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years in warehousing automation, logistics, or supply chain operations.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD 2D layout design (required).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Comfort working both independently and within a collaborative team.
  • Willingness to travel to client and project sites as needed.


Nice to have

  • Project management experience.
  • WMS/WES/WCS integration experience.
  • Full English Proficiency

title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies

Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen.


Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür.


Was du machst

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.


Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst.


Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden.


Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch.
  • Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.


Was zusätzlich hilft

  • Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse
  • Englisch fließend
  • Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university

Compensation range

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

About Client

Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.


Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns:


Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus.

About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide.


As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists to join our global network of creators.


Role Overview


As a Freelance Voice Over Artist, you will bring complex characters and gripping stories to life in serialized audio fiction. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series.


This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration.


Requirements


  • Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles.
  • Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting.
  • Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet.
  • Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules.
  • Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions.


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management
  • Experience working remotely with production teams


Engagement Details

  • Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote (Work from your own studio)
  • Compensation: Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis.

How to Apply : Please fill in


What happens after you apply?


Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline:

1.Internal Evaluation:

Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects.

2.Show Casting & Voice Testing:

If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision.

3.Contract & Legal Alignment:

Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms.

4.Calibration & Onboarding:

Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow.

5.Production & Monthly Deliveries:

Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span 150 to 300 hours in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of 20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month until the series is complete.

title: Senior DBA + C#/.NET Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DBA + C#/.NET Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior Database Administrator with C#/.NET development experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will interact with/improve code related to our software database queries, while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Head of Risk (Crypto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Risk (Crypto) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)


About the Company:

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it.


The Role:

We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity.


This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth.


Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake.


We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk.
  • Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy.
  • Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities.
  • Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making.
  • Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks.
  • Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies.
  • Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation.
  • Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls.
  • Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives.
  • Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them.
  • Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level.
  • Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk.
  • Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers.
  • Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector.
  • Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de Move, Migration e Upgrades SAP.
  • Atuação como especialista em arquiteturas SAP em hyperscalers certificados SAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em: SAP S/4HANA; Arquitetura SAP on‑premise, cloud e híbrida; Ambientes hyperscaler certificados SAP; Integrações SAP; Landscapes SAP, governança técnica e migração de dados.
  • Forte capacidade de análise, identificação e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Diferenciais:


  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para interação com públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Perfil consultivo, com visão end‑to‑end e forte orientação à solução.
  • Experiência prévia em pré‑vendas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos SAP de grande porte e ambientes críticos.
  • Experiência em apresentações executivas e condução de workshops técnicos.

title: Head of Compliance (Brazil resident)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Compliance (Brazil resident) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Head of Compliance on the ground. The authorisation itself depends on having someone the BCB trusts in this seat — someone who treats AML/CFT, KYC, and disclosure as the actual job, not paperwork around it. In your first year, you will have stood up the compliance program the regulator expects to see and built the company's track record with the BCB from zero.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory officer responsibility for compliance at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Own the design and effectiveness of the AML/CFT and KYC program, including transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and suspicious activity reporting
  • Act as the primary point of contact with the BCB and COAF for compliance matters, including audits, inspections, and ad hoc information requests
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the compliance workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship, with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing officer or director seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • Direct compliance experience at a BCB-regulated institution (bank, securities broker/distributor, foreign exchange dealer) or at a crypto exchange/VASP
  • Hands-on ownership of AML/CFT and KYC programs, not just oversight of someone else's
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior compliance experience specifically within a crypto exchange or VASP
  • AML/compliance certification (e.g. CAMS, ICA)
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB or COAF on audits, inspections, or filings

title: Senior VIP Relationship Specialist, Brazil
description:

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and driven Senior VIP Relationship Specialist to join our VIP team in Brazil. In this senior role, you will serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for our high-value clients in the region. You will be responsible for elevating the customer experience, fostering long-term client loyalty, and leading localized initiatives to drive business success and market share within the Brazilian and broader LATAM crypto ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Qualifications

  • Proven Track Record: A well-established client network in Brazil/LATAM, including institutional clients, high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs), family offices, private banking clients, brokers, or futures institutions.
  • Industry Experience: Direct experience working within crypto trading platforms, digital asset exchanges, or fintech pioneers is highly advantageous.
  • Financial Background: Minimum of 4-6 years of prior experience in sales, account management, or client services within international financial institutions, commercial/private banking, or asset management.
  • Language Proficiency: Native or bilingual fluency in Portuguese (both written and spoken) is mandatory, along with professional proficiency in English for cross-border corporate communication.
  • Adaptability & Resilience: Proven ability to thrive under pressure, manage tight deadlines, and excel in a fast-paced, multi-tasking environment.
  • Crypto Passion: Demonstrates a deep enthusiasm for the web3 and cryptocurrency industry, with a sharp understanding of the latest trends, regulatory shifts, and innovations in the Brazilian market.
