About Our Client & The Engagemen t

Our client is a premier AI consulting group that builds serious, production-grade systems for companies ready to operationalize artificial intelligence across their business. They eschew gimmicks and prototypes, focusing instead on delivering custom AI that integrates seamlessly into operations to drive measurable results. Their work automates high-effort workflows, launches AI-powered product lines, and transforms internal data into structured, usable assets—ranging from custom-trained models to intelligent agents that reason across complex business logic. Their diverse clientele spans education, financial services, engineering, healthcare, and defense


About the Engagement

A multi-component platform build for an education-sector client: a cloud-native system that ingests school and rostering data into one canonical record, governs access down to the row and field, fronts it behind a single access layer, builds audiences from it, and delivers multi-channel communications to families at scale. It ships as five interlocking components, each with its own scope: a canonical data integration and migration platform; a capability-based access-control service; a unified API access layer over the core; an audience service; and an event-driven communications platform with consent and reporting. We are hiring two senior, interchangeable technical PMs. Each owns one or more components end to end and flexes across all five. You won't inherit a finished roadmap: you'll author scope, sequence delivery across interdependent teams, steer architecture with engineering, and run sign-off and rollout with the client.


What You Will Own

  • Turn ambiguous, architecture-heavy scope into sequenced roadmaps with clear milestones and acceptance criteria.
  • Govern scope and change as designs evolve through discovery, validation, and performance testing.
  • Hold the contracts and sequencing across deeply interdependent component teams.
  • Run client sign-off on schemas, policy models, SLAs, and migration cutover gates.
  • Define and track delivery metrics: success and lag rates, latency, dead-letters, and reconciliation tolerances.
  • Own phased rollout and migration per client: shadow mode, dual-run, cutover, and rollback.
  • Treat compliance as product requirements: FERPA, COPPA, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, TCPA, SOC 2, and data residency.
  • Partner with the client's product and engineering teams on PRDs, governance rules, and vendor selection.

Responsibilities

  • Own one or more components end to end: scope, roadmap, sequencing, risk, and client sign-off.
  • Author each component's scope and architecture narrative, and shepherd changes through client review.
  • Keep the interfaces between components coherent so dependent teams stay unblocked.
  • Set and hold acceptance criteria and quality gates for production-grade delivery.
  • Drive the migration and rollout playbook as reusable tooling: discovery, mapping, dual-run, cutover, rollback.
  • Translate between client business rules and engineering trade-offs: delivery semantics, replay, caching, latency.
  • Track delivery health against SLAs and surface risk early with clear recommendations.
  • Operate as a peer to senior engineering and client leadership in design reviews and sign-offs.

Required Experience

  • 8+ years in product management, several as a senior, principal, or staff technical PM on platform or data-infrastructure products.
  • Track record shipping complex backend or platform products to production at scale (data, API, identity/auth, segmentation, or messaging).
  • Strong technical fluency: data modeling, event-driven systems, API contracts, authorization models, and cloud infra (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  • Proven ownership of scope and change management on ambiguous, evolving engagements.
  • Cross-team dependency and interface management across interlocking services.
  • Strong stakeholder management; able to run and close schema, policy, and SLA sign-offs.
  • Large-scale data migration and phased rollout: dual-run, shadow mode, cutover, rollback.
  • Credible with engineers on distributed-systems trade-offs: idempotency, delivery semantics, replay, backpressure, latency.

Bonus

  • EdTech, SIS, or student-rostering experience.
  • Depth in data integration, access control (ABAC/RBAC), API gateways, segmentation, or messaging platforms.
  • Hands-on with a GCP-native stack (Dataflow/Beam, Spanner, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Terraform).
  • Senior consulting or client-services delivery experience.
  • An engineering or technical background earlier in your career.

description:

Role: Pre-Sales Solution Architect

Location: LATM Region

Responsibilities:

• Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity

qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract

award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional

pipeline.

• Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution

design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and

Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-

quality, fully compliant submissions.

• Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance,

Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping

theCompany portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes.

• Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-

quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise

reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including

customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone.

• Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management &

Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and

rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases

such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and

interference management, and anomaly detection.

• Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and

intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous

networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for

customers.

• Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution

integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use

cases, KPIs, and success criteria.

• Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level

designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand

customer and third-party technical scrutiny.

• Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery

workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical

stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level.

• Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery /

Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties –

operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble

winning and deliverable solutions.

• Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and

webinars – and representCompany at industry events and standards / community forums

such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE.

• Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs

and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the

shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer

conversations and internal strategy.

Requirements:

• Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:• Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and

storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear

business value.

• Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain

for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx

responses and customer-facing technical engagements.

• Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault,

performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management,

and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause

analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).

• Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop

assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum

Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).

• Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT

RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management

interfaces.

• Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS,

PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment

models.

• Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital

Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines,

telemetry, and data lakes).

• Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and

solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal

and external stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel as required.

theCompany portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes.

• Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-

quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise

reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including

customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone.

• Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management &

Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and

rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases

such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and

interference management, and anomaly detection.

• Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and

intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous

networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for

customers.

• Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution

integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use

cases, KPIs, and success criteria.

• Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level

designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand

customer and third-party technical scrutiny.

• Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery

workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical

stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level.

• Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery /

Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties –

operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble

winning and deliverable solutions.

• Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and

webinars – and representCompany at industry events and standards / community forums

such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE.

• Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs

and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the

shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer

conversations and internal strategy.

Requirements:

• Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:• Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and

storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear

business value.

• Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain

for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx

responses and customer-facing technical engagements.

• Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault,

performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management,

and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause

analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).

• Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop

assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum

Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).

• Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT

RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management

interfaces.

• Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS,

PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment

models.

• Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital

Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines,

telemetry, and data lakes).

• Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and

solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal

and external stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel as required.

title: Gerente de projetos Jr
description:

A Studio Rx é um hub de produção da Omnicom Production, criada para apoiar as necessidades das agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Como Gerente de Projetos Júnior, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA.   • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios de andamento do projeto para times locais e globais, apoiando o acompanhamento dos principais indicadores.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), com interação frequente com times globais;
  • Graduação em áreas relacionadas à comunicação (Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Comunicação Social) ou TI;
  • Experiência inicial ou em desenvolvimento em gestão de projetos.

  • Experiência em agências de comunicação/publicidade;

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Technical Product Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Please not that this is a 8month temp-to-perm independent contract



About hirework s

hireworks is building a community of top talent in key international markets by unlocking unparalleled access to positions at leading U.S. based companies. As your employer, hireworks will ensure you have a seamless interview, onboarding, and employee experience - providing ongoing support and resources along the way. Established in 2023, hireworks is forging corp-to-corp relationships with leading U.S. based organizations looking to grow their teams with best-in-class talent around the world. Working with hireworks means unlocking access to a network of local peers and mentors and career opportunities through our client network.


About Our Client & The Engagemen t

Our client is a premier AI consulting group that builds serious, production-grade systems for companies ready to operationalize artificial intelligence across their business. They eschew gimmicks and prototypes, focusing instead on delivering custom AI that integrates seamlessly into operations to drive measurable results. Their work automates high-effort workflows, launches AI-powered product lines, and transforms internal data into structured, usable assets—ranging from custom-trained models to intelligent agents that reason across complex business logic. Their diverse clientele spans education, financial services, engineering, healthcare, and defense


About the Engagement

A multi-component platform build for an education-sector client: a cloud-native system that ingests school and rostering data into one canonical record, governs access down to the row and field, fronts it behind a single access layer, builds audiences from it, and delivers multi-channel communications to families at scale. It ships as five interlocking components, each with its own scope: a canonical data integration and migration platform; a capability-based access-control service; a unified API access layer over the core; an audience service; and an event-driven communications platform with consent and reporting. We are hiring two senior, interchangeable technical PMs. Each owns one or more components end to end and flexes across all five. You won't inherit a finished roadmap: you'll author scope, sequence delivery across interdependent teams, steer architecture with engineering, and run sign-off and rollout with the client.


What You Will Own

  • Turn ambiguous, architecture-heavy scope into sequenced roadmaps with clear milestones and acceptance criteria.
  • Govern scope and change as designs evolve through discovery, validation, and performance testing.
  • Hold the contracts and sequencing across deeply interdependent component teams.
  • Run client sign-off on schemas, policy models, SLAs, and migration cutover gates.
  • Define and track delivery metrics: success and lag rates, latency, dead-letters, and reconciliation tolerances.
  • Own phased rollout and migration per client: shadow mode, dual-run, cutover, and rollback.
  • Treat compliance as product requirements: FERPA, COPPA, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, TCPA, SOC 2, and data residency.
  • Partner with the client's product and engineering teams on PRDs, governance rules, and vendor selection.

Responsibilities

  • Own one or more components end to end: scope, roadmap, sequencing, risk, and client sign-off.
  • Author each component's scope and architecture narrative, and shepherd changes through client review.
  • Keep the interfaces between components coherent so dependent teams stay unblocked.
  • Set and hold acceptance criteria and quality gates for production-grade delivery.
  • Drive the migration and rollout playbook as reusable tooling: discovery, mapping, dual-run, cutover, rollback.
  • Translate between client business rules and engineering trade-offs: delivery semantics, replay, caching, latency.
  • Track delivery health against SLAs and surface risk early with clear recommendations.
  • Operate as a peer to senior engineering and client leadership in design reviews and sign-offs.

Required Experience

  • 8+ years in product management, several as a senior, principal, or staff technical PM on platform or data-infrastructure products.
  • Track record shipping complex backend or platform products to production at scale (data, API, identity/auth, segmentation, or messaging).
  • Strong technical fluency: data modeling, event-driven systems, API contracts, authorization models, and cloud infra (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  • Proven ownership of scope and change management on ambiguous, evolving engagements.
  • Cross-team dependency and interface management across interlocking services.
  • Strong stakeholder management; able to run and close schema, policy, and SLA sign-offs.
  • Large-scale data migration and phased rollout: dual-run, shadow mode, cutover, rollback.
  • Credible with engineers on distributed-systems trade-offs: idempotency, delivery semantics, replay, backpressure, latency.

Bonus

  • EdTech, SIS, or student-rostering experience.
  • Depth in data integration, access control (ABAC/RBAC), API gateways, segmentation, or messaging platforms.
  • Hands-on with a GCP-native stack (Dataflow/Beam, Spanner, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Terraform).
  • Senior consulting or client-services delivery experience.
  • An engineering or technical background earlier in your career.
  • Built reusable migration or onboarding tooling that runs per client.

Benefits

hireworks is cultivating a growing community of top talent across Colombia, Argentina or Bulgaria. In addition to unlocking access to positions at top tier U.S. based companies, we offer a variety of benefits to enhance your experience:

  • Competitive Pay – compensation that reflects your experience and accomplishments.
  • Remote Flexibility – work from anywhere within your local country (Colombia or Argentina), with the option to use co-working space as available locally.
  • Paid Time Off – ample vacation days to rest and recharge.
  • Public Holidays – all local federal holidays are fully paid days off.

title: Instrutor de Idiomas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Instrutor de Idiomas em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! 


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. 


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. 


Seja diferente, seja independente

A Escudo está ampliando seu banco de instrutores e busca Técnicos em Segurança do Trabalho, Engenheiros de Segurança do Trabalho e profissionais habilitados para ministrar treinamentos presenciais nas principais Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) em diversas regiões do Brasil.


Se você atua como Instrutor de Segurança do Trabalho , possui registro profissional ativo , proficiência comprovada, experiência prática e disponibilidade para atuar como Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) , queremos conhecer seu perfil.


Vagas Disponíveis


NR23 – Brigada de Incêndio

  • Santarém/PA


NR37 – Básico – Plataformas de Petróleo

  • Campinas/SP
  • Ribeirão Preto/SP
  • São José dos Campos/SP
  • Sorocaba/SP


NR11 – Tombador

  • Araguari/MG


Instrutores para as NR's nas Regiões (Curitiba/PR, Araucária/PR e Lages/SC): 

  • NR13
  • NR17
  • NR18
  • NR20
  • NR22
  • NR23
  • NR31
  • NR33
  • NR33 – Supervisor
  • NR35


✅ Requisitos

  • Formação em Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho ou Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho .
  • Para NR23 , formação como Bombeiro e credenciamento ativo junto ao Corpo de Bombeiros Militar (quando exigido pela legislação estadual).
  • Registro profissional ativo.
  • Certificações e habilitações específicas das NRs que irá ministrar.
  • Experiência prática comprovada na área de atuação.
  • Boa comunicação, didática e domínio das Normas Regulamentadoras.
  • CNPJ ativo para prestação de serviços (PJ).


Como comprovar sua proficiência?

Será necessário apresentar:

  • Diplomas e certificados de formação.
  • Certificados de reciclagem e atualizações obrigatórias das NRs.
  • Declarações de competência técnica emitidas por empresas onde atuou como instrutor.
  • Evidências de treinamentos realizados (fotos, registros ou outros documentos, quando aplicável).


🛠️ Principais responsabilidades

  • Ministrar treinamentos presenciais conforme as Normas Regulamentadoras vigentes.
  • Conduzir atividades práticas e teóricas com foco em segurança e qualidade.
  • Avaliar o desempenho dos participantes.
  • Encaminhar toda a documentação obrigatória após os treinamentos.
  • Assinar listas, certificados e documentos técnicos, quando aplicável.
  • Manter sua documentação profissional e comprovações de proficiência sempre atualizadas.


O que oferecemos

  • Formação exclusiva para Instrutores Escudo.
  • Materiais didáticos, apostilas e avaliações.
  • Vouchers de desconto para cursos.
  • Suporte operacional antes, durante e após os treinamentos.
  • Oportunidade de atuar em diferentes regiões do Brasil, ampliando seu portfólio profissional e sua rede de clientes.

title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager to join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.


Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for sellers, addressing issues related to registration, compliance, listing support, and account management promptly and professionally based on the guidance of global teams.
  • Assist sellers in understanding platform policies, documentation requirements, and troubleshooting steps, including but not limited to product listing errors, payment delays, or compliance violations.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Legal, Compliance, Product) to support the resolution of seller escalations and improvement of processes.
  • Analyze seller pain points and feedback to propose platform or workflow optimizations.
  • Conduct training sessions to provide information support for sellers on best practices for account health and growth.
  • Track seller performance metrics (e.g., onboarding completion rates, issue resolution time) and report trends to leadership.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Operações de Turismo
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operações de Turismo em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à nossa equipe na Viagem Alemanha!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Assistente de Operações para integrar a nossa equipe na Viagem Alemanha, uma agência boutique de turismo receptivo especializada em experiências de viagem personalizadas e de alta qualidade na Alemanha.


Resumo da Posição:

Como Assistente de Operações, você será responsável por apoiar as atividades diárias relacionadas ao planejamento e execução dos roteiros de nossos clientes, garantindo que cada detalhe seja cuidado para proporcionar experiências inesquecíveis. Este é um trabalho 100% remoto, permitindo que você atue de qualquer lugar do Brasil. O horário é flexível, mas exige disponibilidade para iniciar cedo, com uma jornada diária de 8 horas.


O que estamos procurando:

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Boa comunicação em português e inglês.
  • Experiência anterior em turismo ou atendimento ao cliente.
  • Proatividade, disposição para aprender e resolver problemas.
  • Disponibilidade para começar o dia cedo devido ao fuso horário da Alemanha.


Suas responsabilidades:

  • Apoio para confecção de propostas comerciais e material visual.
  • Apoiar na coordenação de reservas de hotéis, transportes e passeios.
  • Manter contato com fornecedores e parceiros locais para confirmar serviços.
  • Acompanhar e atualizar cronogramas de viagem.
  • Resolver pequenas demandas operacionais e contribuir com a qualidade do serviço prestado.


O que oferecemos:

  • Oportunidade de trabalho remoto, com flexibilidade para atuar de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor, com uma equipe dedicada com foco na excelência dos serviços prestados e realização dos clientes.
  • Treinamento e suporte contínuos para o desenvolvimento profissional.
  • A chance de atuar em uma empresa com forte reputação no mercado de turismo alemão.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento de Canva e Google Drive
  • Experiência anterior em turismo ou atendimento ao cliente
  • Conhecimento básico de Claude
  • Inglês escrito e falado ambos nível avançado (só serão confirmadas as entrevistas de candidatos que tenham este requisito)
  • Pelo menos 2 anos completos de experiência comprovada no setor de turismo


Interessado(a)?

Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que transforma viagens em experiências extraordinárias!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Private Equity Mentor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Click the following link to submit your application today:


Wall Street Oasis (WSO) | Mentorship Program

3,000+ Mentors | 1+ Million Students | Global Reach


Our top mentors earn $50K–$100K+/year , some even earn $3K in a single week (if you qualify to become a head mentor inside WSO Academy) ... work from anywhere, any timezone


Wall Street Oasis (WSO) is expanding its Mentorship Program, and we're looking for outstanding professionals to join our mentor roster... an elite network supporting students and young professionals as they prepare for high-stakes careers.


What You’ll Do:

  • 1-on-1 Coaching: Provide personalized mock interviews, resume critiques, and career advice... Guide students targeting private equity recruiting , including IB → PE transitions, LBO case prep, and deal experience storytelling
  • Cohort Guidance (Optional): Lead small groups through structured prep sessions, especially around IB and PE recruiting cycles
  • Contribute to Content (Optional): Help enhance financial modeling & interview prep standards and improve student-facing materials
  • Mentor With Purpose: Share real-world insight and high-quality feedback to help mentees thrive


Who We’re Looking For

  • Professionals with experience in Private Equity, Growth Equity, or Buy-Side Investing
  • Current or former PE Associates, Senior Associates, VPs, Principals , or IB professionals with meaningful PE deal exposure
  • Strong communicators who enjoy advising and developing early-career talent
  • Consistent, detail-oriented mentors who can provide actionable, real-world feedback


Why Join?

  • Remote & Flexible: Contribute from anywhere, on your own time
  • Credibility: Be part of one of the most respected finance communities globally
  • Impact: Help shape the careers of students from top schools, as well as students who come from diverse backgrounds
  • Low time commitment: Coach just a few hours a month... or more, if you're interested
